description: This file is a PHP source code for an IBM DB2 / Oracle compatibility driver within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines functions for remapping bind variables and classes for database interaction tailored for DB2/Oracle compatibility.

classes.name: ADODB_db2oci
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_db2 for DB2/Oracle compatibility, mainly implementing the `_Execute` method.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_db2oci
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_odbc specific to DB2/Oracle via this driver.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes SQL with optional parameter remapping for bind variables.
